author: J.F.Gmelin, 1789
summary: 모래밭과 자갈밭, 바닷가 풀밭에서 번식하는 새로, 한 곳에 둥지 여러 개를 튼다. 번식기는 5월 초부터 8월 초까지이며, 암컷은 보통 알 2~3개를 낳는다. 알은 22~23일 만에 부화하고, 새끼는 부화 뒤 23~35일 동안 어미에게 의지한다. 미국 동부와 남쪽 해안에서 번식하고 미국 남쪽 해안에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Gull-billed Tern (Gelochelidon nilotica), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean coasts on spring passage (April–May): neat black cap from the bill base to the nape, without a crest; face, neck and underparts white; mantle, upperwings, rump and tail pale grey; outer primaries slightly darker grey at the tips; bill short, deep and stout, entirely black; dark eye; legs black, fairly long for a tern.
art.pose: standing at the edge of a mudflat, side view
art.scene: Korean west-coast tidal flat and saltmarsh edge in May, low tide; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing on mud: black cap and nape, white face and underparts, pale grey upperparts, short thick all-black bill, long black legs
adult winter, side view standing: white head with a black patch through and behind the eye and faint grey streaks on the rear crown, pale grey back, same thick black bill and black legs
adult breeding, in flight seen from below, head, body and tail in line: white body, pale wings with dark tips to the outer primaries, short pale tail with a shallow notch
art.build: Medium-sized, rather heavy-bodied tern, 36cm, a little larger and bulkier than Common Tern, with a broad-winged, gull-like look. Head rounded with no crest. Bill black, about head length or slightly shorter, thick and deep with a blunt, gull-like tip. Legs black and relatively long. At rest the wingtips extend well beyond the tail tip. Tail pale grey, short, with a shallow fork. In flight long, broad wings with dark tips to the outer primaries below; hawks for insects over marsh and fields and picks crabs from mud rather than plunge-diving.
avoid: Do not paint a slender red or orange bill; this bill is short, thick and black.
Do not give it long tail streamers or a deeply forked tail; the tail is short with a shallow notch.
Do not add a crest or a yellow bill tip (Sandwich Tern).
Do not paint the winter head grey; winter adults have a white head with a black eye patch.
